afl-player/692284.topic: Return to games and fastball command
afl-player/692284.question: After his injured-list stint, can Elissalt locate the fastball higher in the zone and repeat his delivery against left-handed hitters?
afl-player/692284.evidence: The official record lists a March 2026 placement on the 60-day injured list and September activation. A January arsenal review identified fastball location, especially against left-handed hitters, as a development need. Those earlier pitch observations do not establish his current post-return stuff.
afl-player/692284.positive: Repeated healthy outings with competitive fastball locations against left-handers, while retaining the earlier reported bat-missing weapons.
afl-player/692284.concern: Further availability interruptions, recurring location misses against left-handers or inability to sustain the arsenal through outings.
afl-player/692284.window: Remaining AFL appearances, followed by the next verified spring-training assignment.
afl-player/692284.status: Monitoring — prior scouting; post-return verification needed

international-player/erick-gonzalez-nica.question: Do González’s reported low-90s-plus fastball, slider and changeup remain competitive and controllable in professional games?
international-player/erick-gonzalez-nica.evidence: August 18 reporting describes a right-hander with a fastball exceeding 90 mph, slider and changeup, plus brief senior domestic and international experience. These are attributed amateur reports, not independently measured velocity, pitch grades or proof of professional command.
international-player/erick-gonzalez-nica.positive: Dated game tracking supports the reported repertoire and repeated outings show competitive location with more than one pitch.
international-player/erick-gonzalez-nica.concern: The repertoire descriptions cannot be reproduced in games, or hitters force him into one predictable offering.
international-player/erick-gonzalez-nica.window: Official signing confirmation, then verified academy games or his first professional assignment.
international-player/erick-gonzalez-nica.status: Monitoring — amateur report; professional translation unverified

international-player/luis-garcia-nicarag.topic: Defensive role and first professional offensive baseline
international-player/luis-garcia-nicarag.question: Which infield role does García actually receive, and what do his first professional games establish about contact and impact?
international-player/luis-garcia-nicarag.evidence: TN8’s April interview confirms Dantos senior-league participation, Dominican training and a reported Texas pre-agreement. García discussed working across positions. This supports monitoring versatility, but does not supply a measured hit tool, power projection or defensive grade.
international-player/luis-garcia-nicarag.positive: Verified assignments establish an infield home and a usable professional sample supports contact and extra-base production.
international-player/luis-garcia-nicarag.concern: Only agreement and biography reporting remain available, with no substantive game evidence of the offensive or defensive carrying skill.
international-player/luis-garcia-nicarag.window: Signing confirmation and initial verified professional assignment.
international-player/luis-garcia-nicarag.status: Limited scouting evidence — specific tool evaluation still needed

international-player/enyel-gonzalez.question: Does González remain at shortstop, and does a larger competitive sample establish enough offensive impact?
international-player/enyel-gonzalez.evidence: November 2025 reporting identifies him as a shortstop with a Giants pre-agreement and U15 international experience. A 25-at-bat tournament sample is too small to establish his hit tool or power ceiling.
international-player/enyel-gonzalez.positive: Repeated shortstop assignments supported by credible defensive reports and a larger offensive sample against professional pitching.
international-player/enyel-gonzalez.concern: A move off shortstop without accompanying offensive impact, or continued reliance on the brief youth-tournament record.
international-player/enyel-gonzalez.window: Official signing and first professional assignment.
international-player/enyel-gonzalez.status: Limited scouting evidence — defensive and offensive tools unverified
